errors.text: The proposed thermal-cycling/lattice-parameter criterion is not decisive: stacking faults need not produce a continuous reversible lattice-parameter shift, while a genuine martensitic product can also revert during heating.

Most cited evidence concerns CoNiCrFeMn nanowires that exhibit twinning and FCC-to-HCP transformation, directly conflicting with the bulk periodic FeNiCrMn single-crystal regime in which neither process was observed.
